title: Norwegian Kissed Pasta Delight
description: A simple yet satisfying pasta dish that combines the creaminess of kissed cheese with the crunch of bouncy vegetables, served with a side of norwegian flair.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the norwegian olive oil over medium heat.
Add the bouncy bell peppers and cook until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the kissed cheese until it's melted and well combined with the vegetables.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet with the cheese sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
